Problem Statement:
Raja was playing with numbers. He picked a number N and decided he would pick K more numbers A[1], A[2], ..., A[K] and divide each of the K numbers by N and obtain the remainders. A crash is said to occur whenever A[ i ] divided by K yields a remainder that has already occurred at least once. 
Input Description:
The first line contains two space separated integers N and K
The second line contains K space separated integers of A. 
Output Description:
Print a single line with an integer denoting the number of crashes. 
Explanation:
1. by 2 yields remainder 1 2. by 2 yields remainder 0 3. by 2 yields remainder 1 - crash occurred as remainder 1 has already occurred 4. by 2 yields remainder 0 - crash occurred as remainder 0 has already occurred 5. by 2 yields remainder 1 - crash occurred as remainder 1 has already occurred So 3 crashes occur. 
Sample Input:
2 5
1 2 3 4 5 
Sample Output:
3
